messages:
Maria (Marketing): Quick sync — we need a one-pager + single-slide pocket brief for next Wed's webinar. Audience = product/security buyers at mid-market + enterprise. Focus bullets: security controls (VPC/KMS/HSM), SLA tiers + when to recommend Hosted/Dedicated/Private, a concise benchmark narrative (latency & unit cost for recommended configs), and inbound routing guidance for AEs. Deadline: EOD Tue. Can everyone flag owners?
Sam (Product): I'll own the SLA decision flow and the short recommend matrix. Will add the 'when to pick' lines (cost vs latency vs compliance).
Leila (Eng-ML): I can draft the benchmark blurb and include 2 datapoints: hosted default, dedicated high-throughput. Quick numbers below — feel free to edit: p95 latency (short prompt, 128t) Hosted ~220ms, Dedicated ~95ms; cost per 1k tokens Hosted ~$1.10, Dedicated reserved ~$0.35. Add callout about prefix/KV cache improvements for chat workloads.
Aj (Sales): For routing, we should include the three lead tags we use so inbound automation sends to correct AE queue: `enterprise-security`, `sla-requires-dedicated`, `private-deploy-interest`. Also recommend an 'intent' checkbox: "compliance-first" vs "cost-optimization".
Tom (Design): I'll take layout and make the one-pager printable + a slide that matches webinar deck. Any brand constraints or legal callouts? Trying to keep it dense + scannable.
Nora (Legal): High-level: avoid definitive claims like "FIPS-compliant" unless we list supported KMs. Fine to say "integrations with customer KMS/HSM supported" and link to compliance page. We should add an "audit & logging" bullet.
Sam (Product): Draft matrix sample (copy/edit):
```
Recommend -> Hosted: low friction, dev/test, < $10k/mo; Dedicated: when predictable throughput or p95 <150ms needed; Private: regulated, KMS/HSM, on-prem/data residency required.
```
Maria (Marketing): Leila — can you turn those numbers into two short benchmark lines for the blurb? Something like: "In our internal benchmark, Dedicated yielded ~2.3x lower p95 latency and ~3x lower unit cost vs Hosted under steady chat workloads." Keep it one sentence.
Leila (Eng-ML): Yep. Draft blurb: "Benchmark snapshot: under a conversational workload (128-token average), Dedicated delivered ~95ms p95 vs Hosted ~220ms, and unit cost was ~3x lower after reserved capacity — ideal for latency-sensitive enterprise UIs."
Aj (Sales): Also add a tiny sales-ready callout: "Recommended ask in discovery: expected monthly tokens, latency SLO, data residency needs." That helps AE qualification in the routing payload.
marketing-bot: Reminder: asset template = https://internal.redwood/docs/marketing/one-pager-template (use 'Pocket Brief' layout). Deadline set by Maria for EOD Tue.
Tom (Design): Pls add the final copy to the template doc and tag me. I'll push print-ready PDF + slide by Wed morning.
Maria (Marketing): Final checklist: 1) SLA decision matrix (Sam) 2) Benchmark blurb (Leila) 3) Routing tags + discovery snippet (Aj) 4) Legal wording for KM/HSM & audit (Nora) 5) Design deliverables (Tom). If you can drop a 1-line confirmation in-thread when done, I'll compile and publish the asset + update the webinar registration page. :thumbsup: 
Sam (Product): On it, will post matrix by EOD Mon.
Leila (Eng-ML): Benchmark sentence dropped into the doc now.
Aj (Sales): Added routing YAML snippet to doc and created the tag list.
Nora (Legal): Posted compliant wording in doc — no claims of certifications.
Tom (Design): Tagged — working on visuals, will send a review link in-channel when ready.
Maria (Marketing): Awesome. If anything blocks you ping me directly. We'll use this for the webinar promo email + the post-webinar field follow-up pack. Thanks! :rocket:
